before: An empty content control always showed Word's English prompt ("Click here to enter text."), whatever language the host translated the editor into: on open, when a control was created empty, and when its content was deleted.
after: The prompt comes from the host's translation through new contentControl.prompt.* catalog keys, read live on open and by every edit that creates or empties a control; a translation that does not know a key keeps Word's default. The catalogs ship the prompts Word writes in each language.
reason: The prompt is the same w:showingPlcHdr content shape, only its text differs; it reduces to the existing canonical primitives, so released participants read it unchanged.
